mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_task SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, task_status = IF(retry_count >= max_retries, 'FAILED', 'RETRY_PENDING'), next_retry_at = IF(retry_count >= max_retries, NULL, NOW(3)), completed_at = IF(retry_count >= max_retries, NOW(3), NULL), lease_holder = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, error_detail = 'maintenance:expired-lease-recovered', updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE record_type = 'INVOCATION' AND task_status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_expires_at < NOW(3)
UPDATE t_ai_task SET input_snapshot = NULL, output_snapshot = NULL, snapshot_deleted_at = NOW(3) WHERE snapshot_retention_until < NOW(3) AND snapshot_deleted_at IS NULL
